name: billing.vertexAi.requestType
description: Sets the X-Vertex-AI-LLM-Request-Type header for Vertex AI requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented billing.vertexAi.requestType behavior.

name: billing.vertexAi.sharedRequestType
description: Sets the X-Vertex-AI-LLM-Shared-Request-Type header for Vertex AI requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented billing.vertexAi.sharedRequestType behavior.

name: model.maxSessionTurns
description: Maximum number of user/model/tool turns to keep in a session. -1 means unlimited.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model.maxSessionTurns behavior.

name: model.summarizeToolOutput
description: Enables or disables summarization of tool output. Configure per-tool token budgets (for example {"run_shell_command": {"tokenBudget": 2000}}). Currently only the run_shell_command tool supports summarization.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model.summarizeToolOutput behavior.

name: model.compressionThreshold
description: The fraction of context usage at which to trigger context compression (e.g. 0.2, 0.3).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model.compressionThreshold behavior.

name: model.disableLoopDetection
description: Disable automatic detection and prevention of infinite loops.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model.disableLoopDetection behavior.

name: model.skipNextSpeakerCheck
description: Skip the next speaker check.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model.skipNextSpeakerCheck behavior.

name: modelConfigs.aliases
description: Named presets for model configs. Can be used in place of a model name and can inherit from other aliases using an extends property.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.aliases behavior.

name: modelConfigs.customAliases
description: Custom named presets for model configs. These are merged with (and override) the built-in aliases.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.customAliases behavior.

name: modelConfigs.customOverrides
description: Custom model config overrides. These are merged with (and added to) the built-in overrides.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.customOverrides behavior.

name: modelConfigs.overrides
description: Apply specific configuration overrides based on matches, with a primary key of model (or alias). The most specific match will be used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.overrides behavior.

name: modelConfigs.modelDefinitions
description: Registry of model metadata, including tier, family, and features.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.modelDefinitions behavior.

name: modelConfigs.modelIdResolutions
description: Rules for resolving requested model names to concrete model IDs based on context.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.modelIdResolutions behavior.

name: modelConfigs.classifierIdResolutions
description: Rules for resolving classifier tiers (flash, pro) to concrete model IDs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.classifierIdResolutions behavior.

name: modelConfigs.modelChains
description: Availability policy chains defining fallback behavior for models.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented modelConfigs.modelChains behavior.

name: agents.overrides
description: Override settings for specific agents, e.g. to disable the agent, set a custom model config, or run config.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.overrides behavior.

name: agents.browser.sessionMode
description: Session mode: 'persistent', 'isolated', or 'existing'.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.sessionMode behavior.

name: agents.browser.headless
description: Run browser in headless mode.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.headless behavior.

name: agents.browser.profilePath
description: Path to browser profile directory for session persistence.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.profilePath behavior.

name: agents.browser.visualModel
description: Model for the visual agent's analyze_screenshot tool. When set, enables the tool.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.visualModel behavior.

name: agents.browser.allowedDomains
description: A list of allowed domains for the browser agent (e.g., ["github.com", "*.google.com"]).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.allowedDomains behavior.

name: agents.browser.disableUserInput
description: Disable user input on browser window during automation.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.disableUserInput behavior.

name: agents.browser.maxActionsPerTask
description: The maximum number of tool calls allowed per browser task. Enforcement is hard: the agent will be terminated when the limit is reached.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.maxActionsPerTask behavior.

name: agents.browser.confirmSensitiveActions
description: Require manual confirmation for sensitive browser actions (e.g., fill_form, evaluate_script).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.confirmSensitiveActions behavior.

name: agents.browser.blockFileUploads
description: Hard-block file upload requests from the browser agent.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented agents.browser.blockFileUploads behavior.

name: context.fileName
description: The name of the context file or files to load into memory. Accepts either a single string or an array of strings.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileName behavior.

name: context.importFormat
description: The format to use when importing memory.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.importFormat behavior.

name: context.includeDirectoryTree
description: Whether to include the directory tree of the current working directory in the initial request to the model.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.includeDirectoryTree behavior.

name: context.discoveryMaxDirs
description: Maximum number of directories to search for memory.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.discoveryMaxDirs behavior.

name: context.memoryBoundaryMarkers
description: File or directory names that mark the boundary for GEMINI.md discovery. The upward traversal stops at the first directory containing any of these markers. An empty array disables parent traversal.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.memoryBoundaryMarkers behavior.

name: context.includeDirectories
description: Additional directories to include in the workspace context. Missing directories will be skipped with a warning.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.includeDirectories behavior.

name: context.loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories
description: Controls how /memory reload loads GEMINI.md files. When true, include directories are scanned; when false, only the current directory is used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.respectGitIgnore
description: Respect .gitignore files when searching.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.respectGitIgnore behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.respectGeminiIgnore
description: Respect .geminiignore files when searching.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.respectGeminiIgnore behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.enableFileWatcher
description: Enable file watcher updates for @ file suggestions (experimental).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.enableFileWatcher behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.enableRecursiveFileSearch
description: Enable recursive file search functionality when completing @ references in the prompt.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.enableRecursiveFileSearch behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.enableFuzzySearch
description: Enable fuzzy search when searching for files.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.enableFuzzySearch behavior.

name: context.fileFiltering.customIgnoreFilePaths
description: Additional ignore file paths to respect. These files take precedence over .geminiignore and .gitignore. Files earlier in the array take precedence over files later in the array, e.g. the first file takes precedence over the second one.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented context.fileFiltering.customIgnoreFilePaths behavior.

name: tools.sandbox
description: Legacy full-process sandbox execution environment. Set to a boolean to enable or disable the sandbox, provide a string path to a sandbox profile, or specify an explicit sandbox command (e.g., "docker", "podman", "lxc", "windows-native").
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.sandbox behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: tools.sandboxAllowedPaths
description: List of additional paths that the sandbox is allowed to access.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.sandboxAllowedPaths behavior.

name: tools.sandboxNetworkAccess
description: Whether the sandbox is allowed to access the network.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.sandboxNetworkAccess behavior.

name: tools.shell.enableInteractiveShell
description: Use node-pty for an interactive shell experience. Fallback to child_process still applies.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.enableInteractiveShell behavior.

name: tools.shell.backgroundCompletionBehavior
description: Controls what happens when a background shell command finishes. 'silent' (default): quietly exits in background. 'inject': automatically returns output to agent. 'notify': shows brief message in chat.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.backgroundCompletionBehavior behavior.

name: tools.shell.pager
description: The pager command to use for shell output. Defaults to cat.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.pager behavior.

name: tools.shell.showColor
description: Show color in shell output.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.showColor behavior.

name: tools.shell.inactivityTimeout
description: The maximum time in seconds allowed without output from the shell command. Defaults to 5 minutes.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.inactivityTimeout behavior.

name: tools.shell.enableShellOutputEfficiency
description: Enable shell output efficiency optimizations for better performance.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.shell.enableShellOutputEfficiency behavior.

name: tools.core
description: Restrict the set of built-in tools with an allowlist. Match semantics mirror tools.allowed; see the built-in tools documentation for available names.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.core behavior.

name: tools.allowed
description: Tool names that bypass the confirmation dialog. Useful for trusted commands (for example ["run_shell_command(git)", "run_shell_command(npm test)"]). See shell tool command restrictions for matching details.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.allowed behavior.

name: tools.confirmationRequired
description: Tool names that always require user confirmation. Takes precedence over allowed tools and core tool allowlists.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.confirmationRequired behavior.

name: tools.exclude
description: Tool names to exclude from discovery.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.exclude behavior.

name: tools.discoveryCommand
description: Command to run for tool discovery.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.discoveryCommand behavior.

name: tools.callCommand
description: Defines a custom shell command for invoking discovered tools. The command must take the tool name as the first argument, read JSON arguments from stdin, and emit JSON results on stdout.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.callCommand behavior.

name: tools.useRipgrep
description: Use ripgrep for file content search instead of the fallback implementation. Provides faster search performance.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.useRipgrep behavior.

name: tools.truncateToolOutputThreshold
description: Maximum characters to show when truncating large tool outputs. Set to 0 or negative to disable truncation.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.truncateToolOutputThreshold behavior.

name: tools.disableLLMCorrection
description: Disable LLM-based error correction for edit tools. When enabled, tools will fail immediately if exact string matches are not found, instead of attempting to self-correct.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tools.disableLLMCorrection behavior.

name: mcp.serverCommand
description: Command to start an MCP server.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mcp.serverCommand behavior.

name: mcp.allowed
description: A list of MCP servers to allow.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mcp.allowed behavior.

name: mcp.excluded
description: A list of MCP servers to exclude.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mcp.excluded behavior.

name: useWriteTodos
description: Enable the write_todos tool.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented useWriteTodos behavior.

name: security.toolSandboxing
description: Tool-level sandboxing. Isolates individual tools instead of the entire CLI process.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.toolSandboxing behavior.

name: security.disableYoloMode
description: Disable YOLO mode, even if enabled by a flag.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.disableYoloMode behavior.

name: security.disableAlwaysAllow
description: Disable "Always allow" options in tool confirmation dialogs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.disableAlwaysAllow behavior.

name: security.enablePermanentToolApproval
description: Enable the "Allow for all future sessions" option in tool confirmation dialogs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.enablePermanentToolApproval behavior.

name: security.autoAddToPolicyByDefault
description: When enabled, the "Allow for all future sessions" option becomes the default choice for low-risk tools in trusted workspaces.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.autoAddToPolicyByDefault behavior.

name: security.blockGitExtensions
description: Blocks installing and loading extensions from Git.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.blockGitExtensions behavior.

name: security.allowedExtensions
description: List of Regex patterns for allowed extensions. If nonempty, only extensions that match the patterns in this list are allowed. Overrides the blockGitExtensions setting.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.allowedExtensions behavior.

name: security.environmentVariableRedaction.allowed
description: Environment variables to always allow (bypass redaction).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.environmentVariableRedaction.allowed behavior.

name: security.environmentVariableRedaction.blocked
description: Environment variables to always redact.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.environmentVariableRedaction.blocked behavior.

name: security.environmentVariableRedaction.enabled
description: Enable redaction of environment variables that may contain secrets.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented security.environmentVariableRedaction.enabled behavior.
